name: 93405 · Sn Luis Obisp, CA
findings: ZIP 93405 (Sn Luis Obisp) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93405 (Sn Luis Obisp) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 93405 (Sn Luis Obisp) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).
